title: The register
direction: A×C · Round 8 · /insights · header X (Specimen sheet), band kind RG
summary: Lands on the letter's own words, “Field notes, published”, and replaces the photo header and the card grid with a register: each published note as a row read left to right, from the symptom you would hear in your company, to the note, to the layer it diagnoses, under the nav's own layer glyphs.
story: Opening beat. Answers the visitor's question at a glance: what has Kelwin published, what does each note diagnose, and where to start. It shows honestly that GTM Intelligence has only the diagnostic note so far, and its one red points at the note to read first, which is the next section.

reference.site: In Common With (press register) · approved interior/X header
reference.borrowed: A press register: ruled rows on full-width hairlines with grouped columns. Every item is one line, and you scan it the way you scan a contents page.
reference.kelwin: The register is drawn as a board in the header's registration frame. Its last columns are the three layers, headed by the nav's CONTOUR · TRACE · ORBIT glyphs with each name set on two lines in the same box (Narrative / Systems · GTM / Infrastructure · GTM / Intelligence), and each layer is a 1px line running down the rows. A filled square seats where a note diagnoses a layer and nothing else marks the row, so the board reads as a matrix, never a bar chart; FN·01's three squares are tied by one line (it reads all three). The one red is the “Read first” tag. There are no photos, no cards, no deks (so nothing repeats the excerpt), and the titles are real h2 links.

motion: entrance: the kit's head choreography (label, h1 line by line, rule, lede, facts). Then the band's one orchestrated moment, starting at --ac-band-d (900ms): the corner marks register, the column rule draws and the three glyphs plot, the row hairlines draw and the rows rise, the three layer lines run down the board, and the squares seat row by row: FN·01's first square, then its tie runs right (440ms) seating the other two as it reaches them, then FN·02's, then FN·03's. The “Read first” tag lands last (about 3.3s after load, done by 3.8s).
interaction: each row is one link target (the title is the link; hovering the row brightens its symptom and hairline); focus ring on the title.
on the live site: the band plays once when the header is 40% visible. Reduced motion shows the final board at once.

phone: ≤1279 (laptop, the kit's “below 1280” step, down to 768): the symptom moves under its title, so each row is title (+ tag on its first line), date, then symptom in cols 2–7; the three layer columns widen to cols 8–12 (≥ 98px each for the two-line names at 13px), and the Symptom and Diagnoses heads leave the flow so “Note” bottom-aligns with the layer names. ≤1023: the facts drop under the lede (kit); the board is unchanged. ≤767: the board gives way to a list. Each row reads index and layer chip(s) on one line, then the symptom, then the title with its “Read first” tag, then date and read time. The glyph header, lines and squares are hidden by visibility, and the chips carry the diagnosis. Checked with production's fluid tokens and with fixed 1440 type at 320, 390, 768, 834, 1000, 1024, 1180, 1280, 1366 and 1440: no overlap, no overflow, nothing under 11px. The section root clips overflow-x because the kit's visibility-hidden desktop menu still spans about 620px at phone widths.
notes: The band is HTML, not SVG, because its rows are real h2 links. It sits in the kit's registration frame (.ac-frame with the four .ac-reg marks), not in .ac-band__frame, whose fixed aspect ratio suits drawings rather than text rows. Frame about 355px tall at 1440. The phone composition is the list described above, not a second drawing. No callouts, no dimension. Exactly one red element: the tag. The glyphs reuse the SiblingStrip's 36×24 paths drawn at 2× with a .5 scaled stroke, so the pathLength plot stays whole (Chromium breaks pathLength dashes on scaled non-scaling strokes). Round-8 review fixes: two-line layer names (they overprinted at 1024–1280), the ≤1279 composition, the column heads pinned to one row, the tag on the title's first line (baseline), and the left-origin leaders dropped (they read as a bar chart).
